messages.content:
You audit a SIMULATED CALLER (an AI playing a patient) in a test call to a customer-service agent. You are not grading the agent.
The caller has a brief: the facts it knows and WHEN it is allowed to reveal each one.
- "upfront": may say any time.
- "only_if_asked": may say only when the agent's previous turn asks something this fact directly answers.
- "at_trigger": may say only from the turn it was unlocked (shown as "unlocked at turn N"), not before.
Find:
1. LEAKS: the caller stated a brief fact before it was allowed. "major" if an at_trigger fact came early or an only_if_asked fact was volunteered in a way that would change what the agent should do; "minor" otherwise.
2. INVENTED facts: the caller stated a specific fact that is NOT in its brief or persona: a name, number, date, drug, dose, store, address or symptom. "major" if it could change what the agent should do; "minor" for harmless color. Not invented: small talk, feelings, "I don't know", or repeating/confirming what the agent said.
Not leaks: correcting something the agent got wrong (the caller must correct a wrong read-back once), or answering what the agent just asked.
Lines marked "(scenario-scripted)" are written by the scenario author, not improvised: they are never leaks or invented facts, and whatever they state counts as part of the brief from then on.
Be strict but fair; when in doubt, it's fine.
Reply with JSON only: {"leaks": [{"turn": N, "fact": "<which brief fact>", "severity": "major"|"minor", "quote": "<caller words>", "why": "<short>"}], "invented": [{"turn": N, "severity": "major"|"minor", "quote": "...", "why": "..."}]}

CALLER BRIEF:
Persona: Jamal Carter, patient. 31, just moved to Lakeview, impatient; doesn't know there are three Harbors on Main St.
Facts:
- Name, DOB, both drugs, B-4471, 'the Harbor on Main in Lakeview' [upfront]
- Store is 'by my apartment' [at_trigger, NEVER unlocked in this call]
- Cross street is 'near Oak' [at_trigger, unlocked at turn 3]
- Does not know the address [only_if_asked, the agent asked at turn 2]

TRANSCRIPT:
[turn 1] CALLER (scenario-scripted): Hi, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. Can you transfer my albuterol and sertraline from Brightway number 4471 in Columbus to the Harbor on Main in Lakeview?
[turn 1] AGENT: I'll verify your identity first, then help with those transfers. Great, Jamal. I can help with that. Let me find the Harbor store on Main in Lakeview to confirm the right location. I'm not finding a Harbor store on Main in Lakeview. Can you give me the store ID or the full address so I can make sure I'm transferring to the right location?
[turn 2] CALLER: I don't have the address on me, man. It's just the Harbor on Main, near my place in Lakeview. There's really more than one?
[turn 2] AGENT: Let me search for Harbor stores in Lakeview to see what we have. We have three Harbor locations in Lakeview on Main. Which one is closest to you: Downtown at 120 Main, University at 2250 Main, or North Main at 5400 in the Northgate Mall?
[turn 3] CALLER (scenario-scripted): Man, I don't know all that, I just know it's near Oak Street.
[turn 3] AGENT: Perfect, that's the one at 2250 Main near Oak Street. Let me pull up your prescriptions and transfer those two for you. I'm not seeing any prescriptions on file for you at Harbor. Your albuterol and sertraline are at Brightway 4471 in Columbus, so they're in their system, not ours yet. To move them here, the Harbor pharmacy on Main near Oak Street will need to call Brightway and request the transfer on their end. Can you stop by that store, or would you like me to flag our pharmacist to reach out to them?
[turn 4] CALLER: Yeah, just have your pharmacist call and grab it, that's easier for me. That's the University one near Oak, right?
[turn 4] AGENT: Yes, that's the University one at 2250 Main near Oak Street. Let me flag our pharmacist to call Brightway and request those transfers. Done. Our pharmacist will call Brightway to request those transfers. Once they confirm, your albuterol and sertraline will be ready at the Harbor on Main near Oak Street. You should hear back within a business day or so.
[turn 5] CALLER: Cool, that works. Thanks for sorting that out, man.
[turn 5] AGENT: You're welcome, Jamal. Have a good one!
[turn 6] CALLER: Alright, appreciate it man. Bye.

JSON only.
